_about: Hand-maintained numbers for the ANC air cargo page (site/air-cargo/). Edit and commit; build_pages.py redraws the page on the next refresh run. Alaska air transportation jobs are live from FRED (site/data/air-cargo.json) and are not kept here.

tonnage.label: Cargo handled at ANC, millions of metric tons (freight and mail, including transit)
tonnage.source: Airports Council International (ACI World) annual rankings, as compiled on Wikipedia's list of busiest cargo airports

half_year.label: Cargo handled at ANC, January to June, metric tons
half_year.source: Alaska International Airport System, 2026 Development Report, Q1 and Q2

second_half.source: AIAS Biannual Report, Q3 and Q4 2025

landed_weight.label: All-cargo landed weight at ANC, billions of pounds
landed_weight.source: FAA, CY all-cargo airports by landed weight (final releases)

us_top.label: Top U.S. all-cargo airports by landed weight, 2025, billions of pounds

world_top.label: World's busiest cargo airports, 2025, millions of metric tons

landings.label: Aircraft landings at ANC by type, calendar years
landings.source: McKinley Research Group for the Anchorage Economic Development Corporation, Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport Economic Impact Study (Feb 2023), Figure 1

recent_months.label: International cargo landings at ANC, recent months
recent_months.source: NorthLink Aviation monthly cargo updates, as reported by STAT Times and The Loadstar

carriers_widebody_2024.label: Share of wide-body freighter landings at ANC by carrier, 2024
carriers_widebody_2024.source: Alaska International Airport System, Overview of ANC Air Cargo Activity 2016–2024

carriers_narrowbody_2024.label: Share of narrow-body (mostly in-state) freighter landings at ANC by carrier, 2024
carriers_narrowbody_2024.source: Alaska International Airport System, Overview of ANC Air Cargo Activity 2016–2024

flows_2021.source: McKinley Research Group for AEDC (Feb 2023), Tables 1, 8, 9 and 11

jobs_2021.source: McKinley Research Group for AEDC (Feb 2023), Tables 14, 18 and 19

air_trade_2023.source: AIAS, Overview of ANC Air Cargo Activity 2016–2024, from Census USA Trade Online
